commands: kubectl get pods,svc -n test-social-network -o wide | head -60

cd /tmp; kubectl get endpoints -n test-social-network | awk '$2=="<none>"'; kubectl get deploy -n test-social-network -o json | jq -r '.items[]|[.metadata.name,(.spec.template.spec.containers[0].ports//[]|map(.containerPort)|tostring),(.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image)]|@tsv'; kubectl get events -n test-social-network --field-selector type=Warning | tail

cd /tmp; kubectl get svc -n test-social-network -o custom-columns=N:.metadata.name,TP:.spec.ports[0].targetPort | head -40; kubectl get deploy -n test-social-network -o custom-columns=N:.metadata.name,P:.spec.template.spec.containers[0].ports[0].containerPort; for p in $(kubectl get pods -n test-social-network -o name | grep -E 'service-'); do echo $p; kubectl logs -n test-social-network $p --tail=5; done 2>&1 | head -80

cd /tmp; kubectl patch svc text-service -n test-social-network --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/ports/0/targetPort","value":9090}]'; kubectl patch svc media-frontend -n test-social-network --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/ports/0/targetPort","value":8081}]'; sleep 3; kubectl get endpoints text-service media-frontend -n test-social-network
agent.summary:
I found two Services with the wrong `targetPort` and fixed both. I confirmed the endpoints now point at the right ports. I did not run a post-creation or media request to test the flow end to end.

- **text-service:** the Service forwarded to port 9999, but the pod listens on 9090. compose-post-service logged "Connection refused" when calling text-service, so creating posts was failing. I set `targetPort` to 9090.
- **media-frontend:** the Service forwarded to port 8080, but the container listens on 8081. I set `targetPort` to 8081. I didn't see this one in the logs, but the mismatch was clear from the port comparison.

The other Services already matched their containers' ports. All pods were Running with no restarts.

Some other services logged MongoDB index errors at startup. They retried and then started, so I left them alone.
